description:
[Deterministic EU AI Act Annex IV Technical Documentation validator. Pure compliance audit, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits and validates the completeness of technical documentation required for High-Risk AI systems under Article 11 and Annex IV of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, scoring Section 1 through Section 6 completeness.
Usage: Use this tool to verify technical documentation readiness prior to CE marking and EU Declaration of Conformity.
Returns: JSON object with { systemName: string, overallCompletenessScorePercent: number, complianceVerdict: string, ceMarkingEligible: boolean, missingStatutoryElements: array, sectionAudit: object, generatedExecutiveSummary: string }.

accuracyMetricsBenchmarked.description: Section 2: System accuracy and performance metrics benchmarked

architectureDescriptionProvided.description: Section 1 & 2: System architecture and design choices documented

biasMitigationDocumented.description: Section 2(b): Bias mitigation and fairness testing documented

cybersecurityRobustnessAssessed.description: Section 2(e): Cybersecurity and adversarial robustness tested (Art. 15)

humanOversightProtocolsDefined.description: Section 4: Human oversight protocols and stop button specified (Art. 14)

intendedPurpose.description: Statutory intended purpose as defined in Annex IV section 1(a)

postMarketMonitoringPlanDefined.description: Section 5: Post-market monitoring plan and incident reporting defined (Art. 72)

providerName.description: Legal name of the provider established in the Union

riskManagementSystemDocumented.description: Section 3: Continuous risk management system documented (Art. 9)

systemName.description: Official name of the High-Risk AI system

trainingDatasetProvenanceDeclared.description: Section 2(b): Training data provenance and data governance documented (Art. 10)

name: ai_act_technical_dossier_builder
